name: Greater Rivenspell
body:
You gain more energy from a spell you rive than most archons.

Prerequisite: Archon 4

Benefit: You treat spells of 1st level or higher as if they were +1 spell level for purposes of all calculations when you use them to power a rivenspell ability.
